stated: The Conservative Party will introduce a new complaints process for the BBC to ensure it does not 'mark its own homework', upholding principles of diversity of thought, accuracy, and impartiality.

source.quote: We will introduce a new complaints process for the BBC so the BBC does not mark its own homework.

bearing_set.reason: An external BBC complaints process directly implicates editorial independence and free expression in public broadcasting — the mechanism is that an external adjudicator with authority over BBC output can shape or constrain editorial decisions, moving the free expression indicator under O9.

The policy intervenes directly in the editorial and speech environment of the UK's primary public broadcaster: external enforcement of 'impartiality' and 'diversity of thought' could expand the range of viewpoints heard (improving speech diversity) or impose a regulatory chilling effect on editorial choices (worsening editorial freedom) — a non-negligible, genuinely contested effect on the freedom of expression indicator.

membership_note: The policy's only material life-outcome bearing is on O10 (personal liberty & free speech), through its direct mechanism on editorial independence and the public-media speech environment. Effects on democratic participation (O9), social trust (O15), or public finances (O12) are too indirect and speculative to clear the non-negligible bar.
